feeds.title: thisisFINLAND » Music
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to showcasing the diverse range of music from Finland. The blog aims to bring the sounds of Finland to a global audience and celebrate the country's rich music culture. The blog covers various music genres such as rock, pop, classical, and folk music, among others. It features news, reviews, interviews, and playlists that highlight some of the best Finnish musicians and music events.

feeds.title: Finnish Blues Society
feeds.description: The Finnish Blues Society is a nonprofit organization that promotes and supports the blues music scene in Finland. The blog features news, reviews, and interviews with Finnish blues musicians, as well as updates about upcoming blues festivals and events in the country.

feeds.title: Iltalehti » MUSIIKKI
feeds.description: Iltalehti is a Finnish daily newspaper that covers various news topics, including music. The MUSIIKKI (music) section of the website features news, reviews, and interviews with Finnish and international musicians.

feeds.title: Finland Today » Music
feeds.description: Finland Today is an English-language news website that covers various news topics related to Finland. The Music section of the website features news, reviews, and interviews with Finnish musicians and covers music events in Finland.

feeds.title: One Chord To Another
feeds.description: One Chord To Another is a Finnish pop site. Or at least once was, but after 20 years or so it's difficult to change the subtitle. When I started this on the 17th of September, 2001, the main focus was on Finnish pop music, but over the years it has drifted more and more towards the country, folk and Americana. Most of the music on this blog will fit into genres such as guitar pop, power pop, indie pop, sunshine pop, country, alt-country, Americana, folk, etc.

feeds.title: Let The Bass Get You
feeds.description: Let The Bass Get You is one of the biggest bass blog in Europe! Let The Bass Get You is a Finnish electronic music blog founded in 2013. L.T.B.G.Y. focuses on bringing new producers and artists to the spotlight, as well as following what's happening in the EDM scene around the world right now. The blog is hosted by Nooa Riitijoki, young man from Finland.

feeds.title: Tuonela Magazine
feeds.description: Tuonela Magazine is a webzine that covers various music genres, including metal, rock, and folk music. The magazine features news, reviews, and interviews with Finnish and international musicians, as well as updates about music events and festivals in Finland.

feeds.title: Fonal Records
feeds.description: Fonal Records is a record label based in Turku, Finland, specializing in experimental and psychedelic music. The label was founded in 1995 and has since released music from various Finnish artists, including Paavoharju, Lau Nau, and Islaja, among others. The blog features news and updates about the label's latest releases, upcoming shows and tours, and other related content.

feeds.title: Gramophone Records Finland
feeds.description: Gramophone Records is a Helsinki-based record store that specializes in new and used vinyl records. The store carries a wide range of music genres, including rock, jazz, electronic, and Finnish music. The blog features news and reviews of new and upcoming releases, interviews with musicians, and updates about music events in Finland.
